tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search active products by name, SKU, description or category. Returns current public prices and stock indication.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Get full details of one active product by product ID or slug.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Check current available stock for a product by ID or slug.

tools.name: calculate_shipping
tools.description: Calculate configured ShiftBD delivery charge for inside or outside delivery area.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a cash-on-delivery order only after explicit customer confirmation. Supply a unique idempotency_key for each logical order and reuse the SAME key when retrying that order; never generate a new key for a retry. Reusing a key with different order details is rejected.
